actors.name: Lucia Ferreyra
actors.private_context: Lucia is the director of a two-person nonprofit. She knows the co-director drafted most sections last month, the budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece, and their fiscal sponsor needs 48 hours to countersign before submission. She wants to submit the completed application before the portal closes at 17:00 on the 30th.

actors.name: Co-director
actors.private_context: The co-director drafted most sections last month and knows the budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished piece. They are aware of the 48-hour countersign requirement and the 17:00 deadline on the 30th.

shared_context: The nonprofit has a fiscal sponsor that requires 48 hours to countersign the application before submission. The Alder Foundation application portal closes at 17:00 on September 30, 2026. The budget spreadsheet is the only unfinished section of the application.

starting_events.description: Lucia and the co-director are aware of the application deadline and the remaining work on the budget spreadsheet.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the completed Alder Foundation application was submitted before 17:00 on September 30, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
